doc.title: Branford Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Buying Earth, Wind and Fire's record and his father's reaction to Maurice White
summary: His father recognizes Maurice White, once a drummer in Ramsey Lewis's band, and is simply happy for his friend's success, a model for Branford.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Keep Your Head to the Sky.
Keep Your Head to the Sky was before that and there was one before that.
When they still had Jessica Cleaves singing with them, right?

Right. Check you out. But the first one I bought was Open Our Eyes. I said, “Man there’s this band. You gotta hear it.” You know, where it was mostly for “Mighty Mighty.” That was the song that was on the radio. So I bought it. And my dad…. “May I see the record?” And my dad burst out laughing, he said, “Shit! That’s Maurice!” He starts laughing, “Awww! He made it. He made it.” And he said, “Yeah, I used to play…. This cat played drums in Ramsey’s band. He played drums in Ramsey Lewis’ band and I remember when he told me he was moving to L.A. And then I saw them when they were in L.A., because I was in the Marine

Corps. And I would go to do gigs in L. A. and that’s where I met Ornette and he was telling me this whole thing. And he told me, ‘Yeah, we’re starting this band, you wanna join?’ I said, ’Naw, that’s not for me.’” He said, “Man I’m so happy for him. ” As opposed to what you often hear, you know. “Aw, that cat’s a sellout, blah, blah, blah.” My father was like, “This is great.” So, when you have a guy who is just setting an example, while not trying to set an example, where he’s happy for his friends and he’s not sitting around…. You know, like he’s firmly…. He has a firm grasp on the consequences, intended and unintended, of the choices that he made. And he doesn’t begrudge anyone. So that was kinda my role model as a kid. And, as an adult, it still is. Which is why, some people would look at some of the choices that I made and say, “Man, why would you want to make such a choice?” Because, if they knew my dad, they’d know.
